<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1238
Claimant:
Sarah Carr
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2025-02-14
Claim opened after a report that the insured's vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant
states the other vehicle came through on the opposing approach as the turn was being completed.
2025-03-11
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at the
time of loss.
2025-03-18
Police report obtained. Responding officers confirm the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene and the
account matches the initial notice.
2025-04-17
Photographs from the scene and the other driver's statement both describe the collision in the same way as the
claimant. Two independent witnesses gave accounts consistent with the reported sequence.
2025-04-26
Vehicle inspected. The damage is largely consistent with the impact described, concentrated on the front driver-side
corner and the adjacent door panel.
2025-05-19
Checked prior claim and repair history for the vehicle. No earlier damage to this area or any other area has been
recorded.
2025-06-02
Confirmed the loss occurred after the coverage start date. Nothing in the file points to damage existing before the
policy took effect.
2025-06-06
Claimant reported neck and back strain following the collision and was seen at a clinic the same day. Medcial records
describe symptoms that fit the type and force of this impact.
2025-07-08
Checked the claimant's medical history for prior complaints involving the neck or back. No earlier injury to the same
body area has been found.
2025-08-18
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of strain. Records are being requested from
the traeting provider to review the course of care.
2025-08-19
Each conversation with the claimant has produced the same account of how the collision happened and what
symptoms followed. No inconsistencies have been noted to date.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
